answer: Newcomers are stamped in series here, never in parallel. Each one must publish a fresh digest over the whole current roll, and every accepted identity lengthens that roll, so the next stamp is recomputed from scratch before a beacon fixes its place in the order. A batch of k aliases cannot be built side by side, since each stamp invalidates the inputs the others were prepared from; total work grows with the square of the batch and most is discarded. The meadow of precomputed proofs stays bare, nothing pools, and a farm burns ferrous seals across its own tundra while a lone agent files once.
